title: ValidationResult
description: Outcome of one Rust validate job attempt on a draft (OQ-02 section 4). It runs the shared strategy validator, checks that the longest lookback fits the cohort warm-up and recomputes the leaf difference from the parent. draft_digest is the digest of the draft strategy-artefact/1 the job read; it is not a Strategy Version hash, because no version is registered before validation passes. A draft that fails validation receives diagnostics, not critique, and no Strategy Version is registered from it.

ValidDefinition.title: ValidDefinition
ValidDefinition.description: computed_changes is the leaf difference from the parent that Rust computed; it equals the declared changes. It is empty when the version has no parent.

ValidationDiagnostic.title: ValidationDiagnostic
ValidationDiagnostic.description: pointer is a JSON Pointer into the strategy artefact, or empty for the whole artefact.

ValidationCode.title: ValidationCode
ValidationCode.description: Strategy failure codes of the shared validator, plus the derived checks. LOOKBACK_EXCEEDS_WARMUP: the longest lookback is longer than the warm-up. LINEAGE_MISMATCH: the declared changes differ from the computed leaf difference. IDENTITY_MISMATCH: a hash does not match its artefact.
